What Alphastar Mobile is for

Alphastar Mobile helps patients manage their profile, request available home services, check appointment updates, submit and view SMPE forms, manage account security, and get clinic or app guidance. The app does not book in-person clinic consultations or walk-in visits. Available services and app features may change; confirm a service with clinic staff when needed.

Your account and accurate information

Use your own patient account, or act only with valid authority for the patient. Give accurate contact details and a complete home-service address. Keep your details current so the clinic can contact you. If a guardian or representative is needed, follow the clinic's requirements. Do not impersonate another person or use someone else's account or medical information without permission.

Protect your login and PIN

Keep your password, six-digit PIN, and email verification codes private. Use Security Settings for supported changes. Email/password accounts use the app's password-change verification flow; Google passwords are managed through Google. Sign out when using a shared phone and tell clinic staff if you suspect unauthorized access. Do not send credentials in Chat With Us or Agent Support.

Home-service requests need confirmation

A submitted request is not a confirmed appointment. Staff must confirm the service, location coverage, available schedule, and any fees. Not every clinic service is available at home. Complete any requirements shown in Book Appointment, check your address, and review the request before submitting. Do not rely on a loading screen, draft, or an old cached status as confirmation.

Rescheduling, cancellation, and fees

Use Appointment Schedule for available reschedule or cancellation options. Read the form and confirm the action before submitting, then check the resulting status. A reschedule request may need clinic confirmation. Ask staff when an option is unavailable. Confirm prices, home-service charges, payment arrangements, and any refund or cancellation conditions directly with the clinic. These terms do not introduce an automatic charge, penalty, or refund promise.

SMPE forms and medical information

Answer the Student Medical & Physical Examination (SMPE) form truthfully and review it before submitting. Use Medical History to view submissions and their review status. Edit only where the app permits it, or ask clinic staff to correct a record. A submitted form or an approved review label does not replace a clinician's examination, diagnosis, medical certificate, or treatment advice. Keep any printed or saved copy private.

Drafts, mobile data, and app availability

A saved draft only keeps unfinished work on your device; it does not send a clinic request. Draft recovery can fail after the recovery window, storage problems, clearing app data, or reinstalling. Review your answers when reopening a form. Internet access through working mobile data or Wi-Fi is needed for sign-in, live status, submissions, account-security changes, and Agent Support. Cached pages may not show the latest information. Check the confirmation or status before repeating a submission.

Help Bot and clinic support

The Help Bot is an automated guide, not a clinician or a live staff member. Topic replies, English/Tagalog translations, timestamps, and like/dislike feedback help you use the app; they do not confirm a booking, diagnose a condition, or guarantee a staff response. Opening Agent Support is a separate step, and staff availability can vary. For urgent medical concerns, contact emergency services or go to an appropriate medical facility; do not wait for this chat.

Use the app respectfully

Use the app only for lawful, authorized patient and clinic purposes. Do not:

  • Harass, threaten, abuse, or impersonate patients or staff.
  • Submit false forms, knowingly misleading requests, spam, or repeated requests intended to disrupt the clinic.
  • Try to access another account, collect other patients' information, bypass access controls, or share confidential records without authority.
  • Upload harmful files, exploit the app, or interfere with its services or networks.

Privacy and external services

Read the Privacy Policy to understand account information, health forms, drafts, service providers, and support handoffs. Only provide information you are authorized to share. Links and third-party support tools have their own terms and privacy practices. Do not submit unnecessary sensitive information through those channels. Reading these terms does not give blanket permission to use health information for unrelated purposes.

App content and reasonable limitations

Respect the rights in Alphastar's name, logo, software, and clinic materials. These terms do not prevent you from requesting or keeping an authorized copy of your own information. The app can experience outages, delays, or errors; contact staff if a request or record looks incorrect. Nothing here waives rights or responsibilities that cannot lawfully be excluded. These app terms are not a waiver of clinical responsibilities or patient privacy rights.

Questions, concerns, and updates

Contact clinic staff through Profile > Agent Support or info@alphastarlabclinic.com if you need an explanation, help with a request, or a correction. Check the Last updated date for changes. A revised notice does not silently create new charges or replace any consent that is legally required. Keep using current app versions and review the notices when features change.

Email Alphastar Clinic

Using this website

The website provides public clinic information, an automated guide, contact links, and app-download information. It is not a patient-account portal, booking confirmation, medical consultation, or emergency service. Use the Alphastar Android app for its available home-service and patient-form features. Download only through the clinic’s official link when available. Ask staff if the download link or a clinic detail needs confirmation. Do not impersonate others, misuse the chat, or attempt unauthorized access.

Website information and language choices

Clinic information can change. Confirm service availability, preparation, fees, and schedules with clinic staff before relying on them. English and Tagalog views explain the same notices; ask staff if wording is unclear. The Help Bot’s replies and feedback buttons do not confirm a request or send your chat to staff. Opening an email draft or Messenger is separate from sending a message. Reading these pages does not record acceptance or provide blanket consent for processing health information.
